name: Core Ultra 5 125H
process_note: Intel 4 (compute tile, per ARK); TPU lists 7 nm
memory: LPDDR5/X-7467, DDR5-5600, dual-channel, up to 96 GB

passmark.mapping_note: CPU: exact entry. GPU: PassMark pools every 'Intel(R) Arc(TM) Graphics' iGPU (Meteor Lake and later H parts) under 'Intel Arc'; there is no per-SKU entry.

notes: base_ghz is the P-core base. ARK lists 7 Xe-cores (the 135H has 8). NPU 11 TOPS (33 TOPS overall). launch_date from TPU; ARK says Q4'23. Intel tdp_w: default = Processor Base Power, min = Minimum Assured Power, max = Maximum Turbo Power (PL2); PL2 is not comparable to an AMD cTDP maximum. igpu.tflops_fp32 = shaders x 2 FLOP x vendor max GPU clock (single-issue FMA; RDNA 3 dual-issue is not counted). PassMark scores mix TDPs and host devices; treat them as a rough guide only.
